newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken/S-E-Banken merger talks seen - banker.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken/S-E-Banken merger talks seen - banker.

text.p: The chairman of Swedish bank Swedbank expects rival banks Nordbanken and S-E-Banken to resume merger discussions shortly, financial daily Dagens Industri reported on Saturday.

"The Swedish banking sector, for the next 10-15 years, will take the form of Handelsbanken and Stadshypotek, Swedbank and Foreningsbanken, and Nordbanken and S-E-Banken," the paper quoted Swedbank Chairman Goran Collert as telling the Swedish Chamber of Commerce in London.
"I think the two latter banks very soon will take up new discussions about a merger," he said.
Nordbanken and S-E-Banken announced earlier this year that merger talks ended without result.
But analysts expect them to resume, as pressure on the banks increases with the planned merger of Swedbank and Foreningsbanken and Handelsbanken's takeover of Stadshypotek.
Collert did not expect Swedish banks to be bought by foreign rivals.
"Banking will always be locally based. Cross-border mergers are way too difficult," the paper quoted him as saying.
